description: Removes the one notice a host scheduled with event_pass_notice sendAt on a personal event this connector serves; call it for "cancel the scheduled notice", "do not send that reminder". It says what was scheduled and confirms nothing was sent. Hosts and co-hosts only; it requires a personal connector token.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

title: Cancel the scheduled pass notice (hosts)
